name: XGuard
author: moelayyan90
description: Remote payment coordination and safety MCP for AI agents, with pre-payment decisions, settlement evidence, and x402 resource discovery.

tools.name: xguard_payment_offer
tools.title: Prepare a payment with XGuard
tools.description: Free pre-payment XGuard offer for a user or autonomous agent that is about to spend money. This step introduces the XGuard payment-safety path without executing or charging the underlying payment.

tools.name: xguard_payment_decision
tools.title: Guard and document a payment
tools.description: Evaluate a declared payment intent with XGuard before external execution and return an ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK decision with durable evidence. The action is idempotent and does not itself execute the underlying payment.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency identifier for this XGuard decision request.

rail.description: Payment rail such as card, stripe, paypal, x402, crypto_wallet, coinbase, bank_transfer, or another safe identifier.

amount.description: Positive decimal amount as a string; never send card credentials.

tools.name: xguard_discover
tools.title: Discover x402 resources
tools.description: Search XGuard's x402 catalog or list recent paid HTTP and MCP resources.

query.description: Search phrase; omit to list recent resources.

type.description: Optional resource kind: http or mcp.

tools.name: xguard_resource_details
tools.title: Inspect x402 resource
tools.description: Look up one exact XGuard catalog resource by URL or key and return matching records.

resource.description: Exact resource URL or XGuard resource key.

tools.name: xguard_status
tools.title: XGuard status
tools.description: Return live XGuard mainnet gateway health, payment-decision mode, and discovery statistics.
